name: Red Wings Widget
description: Detroit Red Wings NHL schedule widget + companion app: next-game countdown, last result, and division standings.
changelog: Rebuilt the entire Android companion app from scratch using the Frosted Ice & Home Red Sweater template.
Integrated authentic Home Red sweater stripe header with dual white racing stripes and embossed Winged Wheel crest.
Added photorealistic frosted ice rink canvas with regulation center red line, neutral zone blue lines, and faceoff circles.
Rebuilt Hero Matchup Card with frosted acrylic glass, crimson @ puck badge, side-by-side Away/Home layout, and countdown timer.
Restyled Atlantic Division Standings into the dual-column Playoff Seeds (1-4) & In The Hunt (5-8) matrix with glowing Detroit red pill.
Added frosted glass Last Result score clash card and Upcoming Games horizontal carousel.
